newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index drops to lowest level since January.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index drops to lowest level since January.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average fell more than 150 points Monday to the lowest level since January as investors rushed for the exits on heightened jitters over the continued rise in long-term interest rates.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed down 157.11 points, or 2.33 percent, at 6,583.48, adding to a 140-point tumble on Thursday, the last trading session before the Easter weekend.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 4-1 on active volume of 560 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
